Package com.agrialert.alert_manager

Class DataManagerConnector

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.alert_manager.DataManagerConnector
public final class DataManagerConnector extends Object
Utility for binding to DataManager and exposing its operations through RxJava types. All bind operations are performed against the application context and released automatically.
